name: rootloom-memory
description: Optional, local, reviewable project memory for Rootloom users.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit, advisory project memory for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Rootloom Memory is an optional experimental plugin for bounded, repository-owned engineering lessons. It is installed separately from Rootloom Core and never overrides current repository evidence.
defaultPrompt: Retrieve relevant project lessons for this task and verify them against current repository evidence.
